title: Hajj Guide
description: Complete guide for performing Hajj with step-by-step instructions for all days

types_of_hajj.description: Any person intending to perform Hajj opts for either one of the three types of Hajj

types.name: Tamattu
types.description: Making Umrah then Hajj in the prescribed months of Hajj. It is considered the best of the three forms of Hajj that the Prophet Muhammad (Pbuh) urged his followers to perform.

types.name: Qiraan
types.description: Making Umrah and Hajj at the same time.

types_of_hajj.note: If you select Tamattu or Qiraan you must perform the Udhiya (Sacrifice), (Qurbani in Urdu).

days.name: Yawmut-Tarwiyah
days.title: Wearing The Ihram & Stay In Mina

sections.subtitle: Enter state of Ihram
sections.location: From wherever you are residing - hotel, house, etc.

niyyah.translation: Here I am O Allah, (in response to Your call) making Hajj.

talbiyah.instruction: Standing, face the Qiblah recite the Talbiyah:
talbiyah.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ
talbiyah.transliteration: Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk, Labbayk la sharika laka Labbayk, Innal hamda wanni'mata laka walmulk La sharika lak
talbiyah.translation: Here I am O Allah, (in response to Your call), here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Indeed all the Praise, Grace and Sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.

sections.subtitle: Travel to Mina
sections.instruction: Between the time period after Fajr until before Zhuhur go to Mina (preferably in Morning)

sections.subtitle: Stay in Mina
activities: Pray Dhuhr, 'Asr, Maghrib and 'Isha at Mina
sections.prayer_note: Pray two Fard each for Zhuhur, 'Asr and 'Isha. Maghrib is not shortened, and remains three Fard. 'Isha to be followed by Witr.

days.name: Yawmu 'Arafah
days.title: Stay In Arafah & Stay In Muzdalifah

sections.subtitle: Travel to Arafat
instructions: Go to Arafat any time after sunrise
Stopover if possible at Namirah (place close to 'Arafah - there is now a Masjid there)
Remain there until after Zawaal (sun at highest point - no shadow) and listen to the Khutbah
If this is not possible, it is permissible to proceed to 'Arafah, remaining there until sunset
Stand upon the rocks at the bottom of the Mount of Mercy (Jabalur-Rahmah); if not, then all of 'Arafah is a standing place

sections.subtitle: During Arafah
activities: Perform WUQUF (stand and pray), make dua (supplications) and seek forgiveness until sunset
Facing the Qiblah, with raised hands, supplicate and also recite the Talbiyah

best_supplication.instruction: It is encouraged to frequently recite the following - this is the best supplication to recite on this great day:
best_supplication.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
best_supplication.transliteration: La ilaha ill Allahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu lahul mulk wa lahul hamdu wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay 'in qadeer
best_supplication.translation: There is none truly worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all Sovereignty and all Praise, and He is Omnipotent over all things.

sections.subtitle: Stay in Muzdalifah
activities: Pray Maghrib & Isha together at Muzdalifah
In Muzdalifah or Mina, collect 70 pebbles for stoning
Spend the night in Ibadah (worship) or go to sleep until Fajr
sections.pebble_note: They are all the same in size. You can also pick the pebbles in Mina. You will need only 7 pebbles on the 10th, and 42 afterwards (49 total). You will need 21 extra pebbles if you are staying for the 13th of Dhul-Hijjah (70 total). They must not be bigger than a chick-pea. (Approximately 1cm across = 0.39 inches).

days.name: Yawmun-Nahr
days.title: Stoning The Pillars, Performing The Udhiya (Sacrifice), Shave Head, Tawaaful-Ifaadhah

sections.subtitle: Morning in Muzdalifah
sections.instruction: Pray Fajr in Muzdalifah, then leave for Mina after Fajr

sections.subtitle: Stoning at Jamaratul-'Aqabah al-Kubraa
sections.timing: Between the time periods of after sunrise until the night
instructions: Calmly proceed to Jamaratul-'Aqabah al-Kubraa for stoning
Facing Jamarah, with Makkah to your left and Mina to your right
Throw seven stones at Jamarah

sections.subtitle: Performing the Udhiya (Sacrifice)
instructions: If a sacrificial ticket has been purchased, this is a permissible alternative
Otherwise, calmly proceed to slaughter house in Mina for sacrifice

sections.subtitle: Shave/Trim Hair
sections.men: Shaving head is preferable, or cut hair equally from all over head
sections.women: Cut one-third finger length of hair
sections.note: Remove Ihram, as all restrictions are now lifted

sections.subtitle: Go to Makkah to perform Tawaaful-Ifaadhah
sections.timing: Can be performed anytime up to sunset of 12th Dhul Hijjah
instructions: Upon entering al-Masjid ul-Haraam with the right foot, recite Dua entering Masjid
No Ihram required
Start at al-Hajarul-Aswad (Black Stone)
Once Tawaaf is complete, offer 2 rakaats anywhere behind the Station of Ibraheem - or anywhere in the Haram
Recite Surat al-Kafirun in 1st raka'a and Surat al-Ikhlas in the 2nd raka'a
Drink Zamzam water - Make Du'aa
Perform Sa'ee
Upon the completion of the Sa'ee, all restrictions are now lifted
Return back to Mina

leaving.instruction: Upon leaving al-Masjid ul-Haraam with the left foot, recite dua of leaving the Masjid
leaving.translation: O Allah, verily I ask You from Your Favor.

sections.women_note: Women should allow extra days for Tawaf in Makkah in case of menses.

sections.subtitle: If Tawaf Ifaadhah was not performed yesterday
sections.instruction: Go to Makkah and perform Tawaf. Then pray 2 rakaats, drink from Zam Zam and perform Sa'ee. Return to Mina.
sections.note: Tawaaful-Ifaadhah (Tawaaf ul Ziyarrat in Urdu) can be performed on the 10th.

sections.subtitle: Stoning all three Jamarats
sections.timing: From the time period between after Zawaal (sun at highest point - no shadow) until the night

sequence.position: Facing first Jamarah, with Makkah to your left and Mina to your right

recitation.translation: Allah is the Greatest (after each throw)

sequence.after_stoning: Face Qiblah (with first Jamarah to your right), raise hands and supplicate as you wish

sequence.position: Facing second Jamarah, with Makkah to your left and Mina to your right

recitation.translation: Allah is the Greatest (after each throw)

sequence.after_stoning: Face Qiblah (with second Jamarah to your right), raise hands and supplicate as you wish

sequence.position: Facing third Jamarah, with Makkah to your left and Mina to your right

recitation.translation: Allah is the Greatest (after each throw)

sections.subtitle: If Tawaf Ifaadhah has still not been performed
sections.instruction: Go to Makkah and perform Tawaf. Pray 2 rakaats, drink from Zam Zam and perform Sa'ee. Return back to Mina.

sections.subtitle: Stoning all 3 Jamarat
sections.timing: From the time period between after Zawaal (after mid-day) until the night
sections.instruction: Stone all 3 Jamarat with 7 pebbles for each one
sections.leaving_option: Leave Mina for Makkah before Sunset if possible. If you can't leave - Stay at Mina.
sections.note: It is permissible to perform Tawaaful-Wadaa' on 12th day of Dhul-Hijjah (as long as you leave Mina before sunset), thus missing the recommended (but not compulsory) day of stoning.

days.title: Final Stoning & Departure (if stayed in Mina)

sections.subtitle: If you didn't leave Mina
instructions: Beginning after Fajr, stone all 3 Jamarat with 7 pebbles for each Jamarat
Leave for Makkah

sections.subtitle: Before final departure from Makkah
sections.instruction: Perform Tawaaful-Wadaa' (Farewell Tawaf) as your last act

conclusion.dua: Hajj Mabrur (An accepted Hajj). May Allah (SWT) accept your Hajj.
